title: ci: bump mordant to 52896c0
body:
### Problem

- `mordant-baseline.toml` holds a count of allowed findings for each lint and file, not which findings. When a file went over its count, mordant hid the first N findings in file order and printed the rest.
- So the finding it printed could be an old one. On #43728 the baseline allowed three `generic_body_not_generic` findings in `node_fs.rs`, and the change added a fourth, `UVFSRequest::run_from_js_thread`. The CI annotation named `readdir_with_entries_recursive_async` at `node_fs.rs:6446`, which is not in that diff.

### Fix

- `MORDANT_REV` moves to `52896c0cc7c1751bbe29672dbc1f007d7d52f3f3` (scarletindustries/mordant#30). `MORDANT_TOOLCHAIN` stays `nightly-2026-09-01`.
- From this revision a file that goes over prints every finding of that lint, then one line with the number found and the number the baseline allows. A file within its count still prints nothing.
- `target/mordant/over-baseline.txt` counts the same as before, so the job fails in the same cases. The workflow notes describe the new output.
- Verified: a cold run of the job's steps is clean and prints nothing about the baseline. With no baseline, the findings are the same 467 as with `00778d3` (all lints, line by line). A regeneration leaves `mordant-baseline.toml` unchanged.

### Background

- The baseline counts because line numbers move with every edit. The price is that mordant cannot tell a new finding from an old one in the same file.
- The job runs `bun scripts/rust-mordant.ts` over three targets and then tests that `target/mordant/over-baseline.txt` is empty or absent.

<details><summary>Notes</summary>

The new output, with the entry for `src/runtime/node/node_fs.rs` lowered from 3 to 2 on this branch: the three findings in that file (`CpSingleTask::create`, `mkdir_recursive_os_path_impl`, `readdir_with_entries_recursive_async`), each with the note `generic_body_not_generic over the mordant baseline (2 recorded for src/runtime/node/node_fs.rs)`, and then:

```
warning: mordant: 3 `generic_body_not_generic` findings in src/runtime/node/node_fs.rs, and the baseline allows 2. The baseline holds a count, not which findings, so all 3 are shown: any of them can be the new one
warning: mordant: 1 finding(s) over the baseline in bun_runtime
```

A file with a large count prints all of it when one finding is added. The largest entry here is 105 `derived_field` findings in `src/css/properties/margin_padding.rs`. GitHub shows a limited number of annotations for a job, so for such a file the job log is the place to read.

</details>

<!-- robobun:evidence:begin -->
